payload.name: Preserve existing facts on additive memory updates
payload.description: When updating an existing memory with new additive information, preserve previously stored facts unless explicitly contradicted by the new message.
content: Before performing an UPDATE on an existing memory, compare the incoming facts with the current memory content.

If the new information is additive (new names, details, preferences, relationships) and does not contradict existing facts, merge the new facts into the existing content or enrich the memory instead of replacing the entire content with only the new facts.
Do not drop previously confirmed facts unless the new message explicitly corrects or supersedes them.

solves: During memory updates, the Construction Agent sometimes replaces an existing memory's full content with only newly extracted details, silently dropping previously confirmed facts. This skill enforces that additive updates preserve all existing facts and only remove or alter facts that the new message explicitly contradicts, preventing loss of earlier evidence in future sessions.
